scriptLines: FechaServicio = iif(     isNull(FechaServicio),     toDate(null()),     iif(         instr(FechaServicio, '/') > 0,         toDate(FechaServicio, 'dd/MM/yyyy'),         iif(             length(FechaServicio) == 5,             addDays(toDate('1899-12-30', 'yyyy-MM-dd'), toInteger(FechaServicio)),             toDate(FechaServicio, 'yyyy-MM-dd')         )     ) ),

HoraProgramada = iif(     isNull(HoraProgramada) || trim(toString(HoraProgramada)) == '',     toTimestamp(null()),     iif(         instr(trim(toString(HoraProgramada)), 'T') > 0,         toTimestamp(             replace(                 replace(trim(toString(HoraProgramada)), 'T', ' '),                 'Z',                 ''             ),             'yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss.SSS'         ),         iif(             instr(trim(toString(HoraProgramada)), '1900-01-01') > 0,             toTimestamp(trim(toString(HoraProgramada)), 'yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss'),             toTimestamp(                 concat('1900-01-01 ', trim(toString(HoraProgramada)), ':00'),                 'yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss'             )         )     ) ),

HoraSalida = iif(     isNull(HoraSalida) || trim(toString(HoraSalida)) == '',     toTimestamp(null()),     iif(         instr(trim(toString(HoraSalida)), 'T') > 0,         toTimestamp(             replace(                 replace(trim(toString(HoraSalida)), 'T', ' '),                 'Z',                 ''             ),             'yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss.SSS'         ),         iif(             instr(trim(toString(HoraSalida)), '1900-01-01') > 0,             toTimestamp(trim(toString(HoraSalida)), 'yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss'),             toTimestamp(                 concat('1900-01-01 ', trim(toString(HoraSalida)), ':00'),                 'yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss'             )         )     ) ),

HoraLlegada = iif(     isNull(HoraLlegada) || trim(toString(HoraLlegada)) == '',     toTimestamp(null()),     iif(         instr(trim(toString(HoraLlegada)), 'T') > 0,         toTimestamp(             replace(                 replace(trim(toString(HoraLlegada)), 'T', ' '),                 'Z',                 ''             ),             'yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss.SSS'         ),         iif(             instr(trim(toString(HoraLlegada)), '1900-01-01') > 0,             toTimestamp(trim(toString(HoraLlegada)), 'yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss'),             toTimestamp(                 concat('1900-01-01 ', trim(toString(HoraLlegada)), ':00'),                 'yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss'             )         )     ) ),
derivedColumn1 derive(KmRecorridos = iif(     isNull(KmRecorridos) || trim(toString(KmRecorridos)) == '',     toDecimal(0),     toDecimal(KmRecorridos) ),
ViajeId = iif(     isNull(ViajeId) || trim(ViajeId) == '',     toString(null()),     concat(         trim(ViajeId),         '-',         toString(year(FechaServicio))     ) ),

VehiculoId = iif(    isNull(VehiculoId),    toString(null()),    iif(        iif(            left(toString(VehiculoId), 2) == 'V-',            toString(VehiculoId),            concat('V-', toString(VehiculoId))        ) == 'V-043' && year(FechaServicio) >= 2024,        'V-043-1',        iif(            left(toString(VehiculoId), 2) == 'V-',            toString(VehiculoId),            concat('V-', toString(VehiculoId))        )    ))) ~> derivedColumn2

derivedColumn2 derive(RutaHistoricaId = iif(     isNull(RutaHistoricaId) || trim(RutaHistoricaId) == '',     toString(null()),     iif(         startsWith(upper(trim(RutaHistoricaId)), 'RUTA '),         iif(             length(trim(substring(trim(RutaHistoricaId), 6, 20))) == 1,             concat('RH-0', trim(substring(trim(RutaHistoricaId), 6, 20))),             concat('RH-', trim(substring(trim(RutaHistoricaId), 6, 20)))         ),         iif(             startsWith(upper(trim(RutaHistoricaId)), 'R-'),             concat('RH-', substring(trim(RutaHistoricaId), 3, 20)),             iif(                 startsWith(upper(trim(RutaHistoricaId)), 'RH-'),                 upper(trim(RutaHistoricaId)),                 iif(                     length(trim(RutaHistoricaId)) == 2,                     concat('RH-', trim(RutaHistoricaId)),                     upper(trim(RutaHistoricaId))                 )             )         )     ) )) ~> derivedColumn3
